scope: No new validation predictions, validation scoring, market data, assets, architectures, strategy promotion or live changes. All forward/backward passes use a fold-specific training-only cache with joint label completion at or before its cutoff. This is exploratory mechanism research, not independent predictive confirmation.
data: Reuse the exact full-history masks, 125-bar raw OHLCV windows, executable weekly-return and five-bar OHLCV labels, training means and population SDs from rounds 6/10. Training counts 1678,1921,2165. Copy only the selected training arrays to this round. Original batch size128, including final batches14,1,117, is retained.
starting_states: Audit all nine archived MSE20 and nine archived Huber20 model states. Restart only from the nine Huber20 states. Archived states contain no optimizer state; these are new optimizations from saved weights, not exact resumptions of original epoch20.
loss: Return residual e is standardized with the original training mean/SD. Scaled Huber rho(e)=e^2 for abs(e)<=1, otherwise2*abs(e)-1. Always report the common training objective mean(rho)+0.1*auxiliary_MSE. Return-only arms optimize coefficient0 but still report both component losses and the same common objective.

frozen_state_loss_audit.aggregation: Full-cohort row-weighted loss; report each draw and the mean/SD across eight fixed dropout draws. Pair the same draws for matched states. These finite Monte Carlo draws are not an exact expected loss or a confidence test. AdamW decoupled weight decay is not represented as an exact added loss penalty.

gradient_audit.definition: Autograd gradients of full-cohort row-weighted return Huber loss and auxiliary MSE, before clipping or AdamW, with frozen weights. Aggregate gradients across batches/draws before computing cosine. Report shared backbone/geometry separately from private heads, the0.1-weighted auxiliary norm ratio, and0.1*dot(g_return,g_aux)/norm(g_return)^2. Negative cosine is a local Euclidean conflict diagnostic; it does not establish conflict in AdamW updates or harmful predictive effects.

restart.optimizer: Fresh AdamW for each arm. Same saved Huber weights, new fixed permutation stream and CUDA dropout stream in each paired arm. Learning rate is prespecified at one tenth the original rate for a local optimization probe, not selected by results. Retain model/dropout0.3 and all other settings. Compute auxiliary outputs also in the coefficient0 arm; zero auxiliary gradients remain tensors, so AdamW weight decay still acts on the auxiliary head.

budget: 18 frozen-state loss audits and gradient probes;18 restarts=3folds*3seeds*2arms,20epochs each;18 final checkpoints and training-only loss audits. No outcome-dependent extension, early stopping, hyperparameter grid or validation-based selection. One GPU training worker.
analysis: Report all nine matched archived-state differences under eval and eight-draw dropout mean; all gradient signs, norm ratios and projections; each restarted arm versus its own initial Huber state; and return-only versus joint from identical starts. Compare fixed epoch20, with5/10/15 only diagnostic trajectories. Use counts and descriptive means, not independent-sample p-values across overlapping folds or seed replicates. Loss reductions establish possible further optimization under this restart design; they do not isolate learning rate, fresh optimizer state or extra budget, prove original nonconvergence, or demonstrate predictive gain.
verification: Freeze protocol/core source/inputs/old evidence before GPU experiment. Verify causal caches and scales, objective/gradient identities, RNG/mode preservation of audits, and paired restart identity. Replay all36 model states on training rows, all288 dropout loss draws, and the saved18 gradient probes; independently recompute360 training permutations/boundaries and paired comparisons. Save optimizer and RNG states in new checkpoints. Preserve all2106 earlier evidence files. No new validation metrics may be produced.
